messages:
alex: hey — accepted the org invite but can't clone `redwood/infra-config`. browser shows a SAML/SSO block and `git clone` returns 404. anyone know the fastest fix?

maria: welcome alex! quick checks: did you accept with the account that has your work email? did you authorize SSO after accepting? also 2FA?

alex: i think i used my personal GH acct (oops). i do have my work email on that acct but not sure if it's primary. git error: ```$ git clone git@github.com:redwood/infra-config.gitCloning into 'infra-config'...git@github.com: Permission denied (publickey).``` and via https: ```$ git clone https://github.com/redwood/infra-config.gitfatal: repository 'https://github.com/redwood/infra-config.git/' not found```

ben (it): looks like two separate problems: SSH key not added -> permission denied, and 404 via HTTPS -> SSO/SCOPED access. If the account accepted invite but isn't authorized for SAML the org will hide private repos (404). Can you go to https://github.com/organizations/redwood/sso and click "Authorize"?

alex: i clicked authorize but the button is greyed out and says "your account isn't allowed to authorize SAML".

ben (it): ah that usually means the invite was accepted by a different GH account or there's a duplicate seat. I can check org membership. hold on — pinging infra-admin (i'll remove the pending seat and reissue invite to your work email)

onboarding-bot: Reminder: Redwood requires 2FA + SSO for org access. Follow the checklist: https://redwood.dev/onboarding/gh-access :lock:

ben (it): OK done — removed the old invite and sent a fresh invite to alex@redwood.ai. You should see an email. Accept that, enable 2FA if prompted, then authorize SSO and add your SSH key (or use PAT).

alex: got the email, accepted it, enabled TOTP 2FA. Authorize SSO now works. SSH test: ```$ ssh -T git@github.comHi alex! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access.```

maria: great! @ben (it) can you add alex to eng-infra with write access to `infra-config`? alex once you're on the team try cloning again.

ben (it): added alex -> eng-infra, repo write granted. also double-checked SSO mapping.

alex: cloned + pulled + pushed a tiny README tweak, all good. thanks for the fast help :tada:

maria: pro tip: use SSH for day-to-day dev. HTTPS+PAT is fine for scripts/CI. If you run into weird 404s later, check SSO authorization first.

onboarding-bot: Issue resolved? If yes, reply with "resolved" so we can close this thread.
